      Trade-in your device

      Get an instant online estimate of the value of your old device, bring it in to your nearest PB Tech store, and we’ll give you a gift card to spend or share.

      Device repairs

      We have a dedicated team of professionals that can repair phones, tablets, laptops, desktop PCs, servers, monitors and more. We have service centres located throughout New Zealand.

      Phone repairs

      From cracked screens to battery replacements, we can do it.
